objections.quote: But tell me, is this proper twenty-two carat?

coaching_tip: When a customer doubts the hallmark and asks if pearls are weighed as gold, read the HUID out with a magnifier, offer to verify it or test purity on the spot, and split the bill into gold weight and stone weight before they decide.
